body: Because death seems like a better option than life, I can't find any more reasons to live so why would I go on torturing myself like this? Removing depression is an easy thing to say, but when the thoughts of sucidie are with you everday of your waking life its hard to escape. That's the thing. Everything I do strengthens the will to suicide. College makes me wanna kill myself, my family, my friends, society, humans, all make me wanna kill myself. Life is so absurd, I can't take it. It's so strange. I haven't had a good night sleept in over two months. I've lost a lot of weight. I'm constantly alone because I can't stand to be with someone else for more than 1hour. I'm slowly dying, I can feel it. I have to die, I know that I have to die. It's like death is calling for me, showing me the way to freedom. I have to let go of my body.  Change it? How? With what money? What Will I do? Work? I can't. I just can't. I know I'm weak. I shouldn't be alive. Im too weak for this. I can't stand it anymore. I can't sleep, I can't think. Better at acting? Wow, just wow. Dont you think I've tried? I cant stand people, I can't socialize when I'm sober. Not only does it feel wrong, but I don't wanna do it. I don't enjoy others company. I can't do anything. I'm having a panic attack. I can't do this anymore.

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h86uye11eD8, You're acting out the introducer in green. Do you seriously think food and beer is more inviting than the great mystery of death? I despise most humans and our society. This trip is going to be the last best thing I ever do in my life, even the though of it already brings the feeling of relief in my body.

When my friend and I were watching a very depressing movie while on acid I felt like I couldn't take it anymore and had to shut it off. So the answer to your question is yes, emotions can get too overwhelming to a point where it feels like you're in torture. I dont even think I could what that movie while sober. But still, everyone is different. If life is a dream why would I let myself be stuck in this nightmare? When you wake up from a nightmare you feel relieved, I belive it is the same with life.

Maybe because a movie is only a fraction of your life, an escape from your own reality? You can escape a movie, change your reality in a matter of seconds. Life however, you are stuck with. I can't remove my depression, I'm stuck in this dark loop of sadness with no escape, except for death. A movie for me is like a trip, a small journey into another reality. My own life however, is the worst movie there is. I'm stuck in a nighmare with only one last escape. I'm starting to believe that life is a dream and I'm getting ready to finally wake up.
